acceptance: A test enumerates registered adapters and fails if any lacks an entry in the inventory
Every adapter has at least translation and DDL offline cases, or a recorded justified exemption
Offline adapter tests run in T1 (touched core) and T2
context: Closed 2026-10-03 by owner decision. Delivered by #2488 (squash d8cfc57e3fd28cb9e8a28be26df4d02d5682a0e5): tests/unit/platforms/test_offline_adapter_inventory.py enumerates the 49 adapters from get_adapter_imports() and fails on any without an inventory entry (acceptance 1); each adapter has real DDL and query translation cases, with positive exemptions for Polars and InfluxDB (acceptance 2). Acceptance 3 is met through the medium tier only, accepted by the owner: the module is marked unit+medium because importing every adapter from cold exceeds the fast-lane budget, and since #2558 (d419b9488) the medium tier runs in PR CI whenever core inputs change and in trunk.yml after every merge to develop.
description: T2 runs only four local engines, so breakage in the other 50+ adapters must be caught offline in T1/T2. Build a machine-checked inventory mapping every adapter registered in the platform registry to its offline cases: SQL translation/dialect (e.g. tests/unit/platforms/test_athena_sql_generation.py), DDL generation, sql_compat rules, CLI argument wiring. Missing cases become tests in this item (or child items if large).
